content.name: computer-vision-evaluation
content.description: Use when designing, reviewing, validating, or debugging computer-vision evaluation. Trigger for product-linked and task metrics, thresholds, calibration, class/scale/source slices, visual error analysis, imbalance, robustness, corruptions and OOD, regression suites, human review, and release gates. Not for training procedure, annotation operations, or generic LLM and agent evals.
